title: Pure Impcantation
summary: Impcantation cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. The page treats Impcantation as a Ritual engine for other decks, but it has its own Ritual Monsters and Ritual Spell, so it runs on its own. Each Main Deck Impcantation reveals a Ritual card in your hand to summon itself and another Impcantation from the Deck. The one summoned from the Deck then fetches a Ritual card: Candoll searches a Ritual Spell, Talismandra a Ritual Monster, Bookstone recovers a Ritual Spell and Penciplume a Ritual Monster. Impcantation Chalislime reveals itself from the hand to call an Impcantation from the Deck, and destroys a monster by sending an Impcantation away. Crealtar, the Impcantation Originator, the newest Ritual (2019), revives Impcantations with total Level 10. Impcantation Inception Ritual Summons any Ritual Monster by tributing Impcantations, then recycles itself from the GY. Impcantation Thanatosis destroys a card whenever a Ritual Monster lands. While Candoll, Talismandra, Bookstone or Penciplume is face-up, you can't summon from the Extra Deck.
